choices: Combining two functions so the output of one becomes the input of the next
Declaring multiple functions with the same name (overloading)
Writing a function inside another function
explanation: Composition chains functions: g ∘ f means apply f first, then g. In Java: Function<A,C> composed = f.andThen(g); — applies f, then passes the result to g. This builds complex transformations from simple, reusable pieces.
